text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim that cars 'aren't practical' and repeated stance throughout","quality":"argument clarity","description":"The essay states a focused position early and keeps returning to it so the reader always knows what it is trying to prove."},{"evidence":"uses points about drivers still needing to stay alert, laws, and liability","quality":"organization of reasons","description":"The essay lays out several distinct supporting reasons in a logical progression rather than repeating the same concern."},{"evidence":"counterfactual questions about false advertising and a pile-up","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay develops its points with hypothetical scenarios that make the argument feel more concrete and persuasive."},{"evidence":"quotation-plus-explanation in each body paragraph","quality":"evidence integration","description":"The essay does more than drop in quotes from the article; it ties them directly to the writer's claim."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement of each main problem","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending pulls together the major reasons and restates the overall judgment in a controlled way."}]}
